steps: Import fixture; inspect deterministic parser result.
scenarios.oracle: Resolved cards and diagnostics match fixture snapshot.

steps: Start; inspect opening hand; exercise mulligan.
scenarios.oracle: Opening and mulligan preserve counts and one-transaction undo.

steps: Advance existing turn path; observe turn boundaries.
scenarios.oracle: No pass/fail until CONFLICT-TURN-DRAW-001 is ruled; existing path is evidence only.

steps: Apply transition; inspect identity and event.
scenarios.oracle: Ownership, identity and LKI obey engine contract.

steps: Announce; advance priority; resolve or keep guided.
scenarios.oracle: Stack order, priority and deterministic resolution are preserved.

steps: Plan and apply payment or warning.
scenarios.oracle: Payment is deterministic, atomic and non-partial on failure.

preconditions: Strict and flexible colored sources available.
steps: Plan; apply.
scenarios.oracle: Planner preserves flexible source when stricter source suffices.

preconditions: Required color only from flexible source.
steps: Plan; apply.
scenarios.oracle: Flexible source supplies required color without surplus taps.

steps: Plan; inspect source set.
scenarios.oracle: Ordinary sources preferred; drawback source only when necessary.

steps: Resolve source; inspect bundle/payment.
scenarios.oracle: Exact bundle generated once without over-tap.

steps: Resolve activation; add mana; pay spell.
scenarios.oracle: Activation and payment share one atomic transaction/undo boundary.

steps: Select source; resolve ability/payment.
scenarios.oracle: Guided choice avoids commander when ordinary source suffices.

steps: Compile; inspect plan and unsupported boundary.
scenarios.oracle: Only replay-proven plan is automatic; unsupported choices guided/manual.

steps: Undo; redo; compare snapshots.
scenarios.oracle: Undo/redo restore exact prior/subsequent snapshots.

steps: Query live Scryfall; compare contract.
scenarios.oracle: Live response remains online-lane evidence only.
Interaction remains legible/reachable without console errors.

steps: Exercise event; inspect timing, audibility, reduced motion, comfort.
scenarios.oracle: Human AV evidence is recorded only for AV changes.

steps: Run replay; compare final state/events.
scenarios.oracle: State/events match golden fixture; partial effect is not automatic.

steps: Move without declaring cause; inspect claims.
scenarios.oracle: Geometry never invents Magic meaning.

preconditions: Canonical state differs from agreed reality.
steps: Apply human Correction; run conflicting automation.
scenarios.oracle: Human-confirmed Correction remains authoritative.

steps: Cause Trigger; inspect memory; correct if needed.
scenarios.oracle: Bounded automation is observable and yields to Correction.

steps: Observe first-player default; use turn-zero checkpoint; begin Turn 1.
scenarios.oracle: Solo user is first and Manual-first turn-zero opportunity exists.

steps: Advance Normal; repeat Full Control.
scenarios.oracle: Normal may skip safe empty stops; Full Control exposes supported stops.

steps: Request HOLD; approve; perform work; return.
scenarios.oracle: HOLD is approved/identity-bound and never steals parent ownership.

steps: Undo once; inspect; undo again.
scenarios.oracle: Each Undo reverts one actor-owned committed unit; no mega-undo.

preconditions: Room Owner and another participant exist.
steps: Disconnect/reconnect; explicitly remove; inspect objects.
scenarios.oracle: Disconnect is not elimination; removal is attributable; objects leave ordinary participation without becoming Exile.
